description_en: Create a configuration group. A configuration group contains settings for scheduled tasks on cloud desktops
description_zh: 创建配置组。配置组中包含云电脑中心定时任务的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-config-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name Scheduled_task_group --description Scheduled_task_description_content --type Timer --product-type CLOUD_DESKTOP --config-timers '[{"TimerType":"TIMER_BOOT","TriggerType":"Standard","SegmentTimers":[{"Timezone":"example-string","TriggerType":"example-string","LockScreenTime":1800,"VerificationNotificationTime":1,"EndCronExpression":"example-string","NotificationTime":1,"PatchId":"KB5082063","IpSegments":["example-string"],"AppointmentTimer":1764660600967,"Enforce":true,"ProcessWhitelist":["example-string"],"ImageId":"m-5b0vjqbiqu010XXXXXX","ResetType":"example-string","OperationType":"example-string","StartCronExpression":"example-string","VerificationTime":1,"TimerOrder":1,"CreateSnapshot":true,"Interval":1}],"Enforce":true,"ProcessWhitelist":["chrome"],"AllowClientSetting":true,"ResetType":"RESET_TYPE_SYSTEM","NotificationTime":1,"CronExpression":"0_0_16_0_0_1,2,3,4,5,6,7","OperationType":"Shutdown","Interval":10}]' --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou

></notice>
